candidates.summary: the PR's Compatibility claim is false: a same-block `cur, x := ...` that never forwards cur compiled and ran on the merge base and is rejected at preprocess here
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm whose crossing function contains `cur, x := cur.Previous(), 1` and never passes the rebound cur to a crossing call. installInheritedCur's identity check only runs on a crossing entry, so on the merge base b7845fb2d this source preprocessed, ran and printed `ok`. At 6d88deba7 the write rule moved after the DEFINE/ASSIGN branch rejects it at preprocess: `zrealm_cur_nofwd.gno:9:2-29: cannot reassign the crossing `cur` parameter`. Packages are re-preprocessed when loaded from the store, so an already-deployed realm carrying that shape stops loading rather than stopping at a call. The PR body's Compatibility section asserts the opposite ("No `.gno` source that compiled and ran before is rejected now ... the `DEFINE` rebind they still reject was already fail-closed at call time"), and that sentence is what a maintainer reads to decide no addpkg-rejection or reload risk exists.
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/b2-claims-r2-define-rebind-no-forward.gno gnovm/tests/files/zrealm_cur_nofwd.gno at 6d88deba7 and at b7845fb2da9a21bfb895e1c008f016776f8342d0, then `go test ./gnovm/pkg/gnolang/ -run 'TestFiles/zrealm_cur_nofwd.gno$'` in each: head FAILs at preprocess, base is ok
candidates.evidence: head 6d88deba7: `--- FAIL: TestFiles/zrealm_cur_nofwd.gno ... unexpected panic: gno.land/r/demo/curnofwd/zrealm_cur_nofwd.gno:9:2-29: cannot reassign the crossing `cur` parameter: it names the realm this frame is executing as, and that binding is fixed for the life of the frame`. merge base b7845fb2d, same file, same command: `ok  github.com/gnolang/gno/gnovm/pkg/gnolang 0.040s`. The fixture forwards nothing, so the runtime check the claim leans on never fires.

candidates.summary: funcDisplayName's source-location branch, the substance of fix 4, is pinned by nothing: deleting it leaves TestFuncDisplayName and every zrealm_cur filetest green
candidates.failure_scenario: A real function-literal FuncValue always has Source set, so the `if fv.Source != nil` arm is the only one that fires in production; the `<func literal>` arm TestFuncDisplayName pins is unreachable for a literal built by doOpFuncLit. Deleting the Source arm silently regresses the identity panic from `gno.land/r/demo/x func literal at file.gno:7` back to the bare `gno.land/r/demo/x.<func literal>` the ADR says fix 4 replaces, and nothing anywhere in the tree turns red: `func literal at` matches only op_call.go:573.

The proposed fixture renders `crossing function gno.land/r/demo/curlitname func literal at zrealm_cur_litname.gno:7 was entered without cross(), ...`.
